name: Medication
overview: Scripture acknowledges the role of medicine and healing, highlighting that a joyful heart can act like medicine to the body, promoting health and vitality, while a broken spirit harms it (Proverbs 17:22). The Bible also warns against the misuse of substances like wine and strong drink, which can deceive and lead to unwise behavior (Proverbs 20:1; Ephesians 5:18). Believers are called to present their bodies as holy sacrifices to God, implying careful stewardship of physical health (Romans 12:1), and the mention of Luke as a physician in Colossians 4:14 affirms the value of medical knowledge within the Christian community.
